title: Oozy Umami Thai Tofu Yum Salad
description: A one-pot Thai dish featuring umami flavors and a cheese-pull effect, made with dried oregano and served as a yum salad. This shojin-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the dried oregano, lime juice, fish-free sauce, salt, and pepper.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Add the mixed greens to the pot and stir to combine.
Shock the mixture in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Serve the salad hot, garnished with additional dried oregano if desired.
